data.name: Khadijeh
data.gender_notes: Khadijeh is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A child born before its due time. Also interpreted as 'a respectable lady'. The name Khadijeh carries the meaning “Premature child” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khadijeh usually hope their child will grow to embody premature child and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The first wife of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and the first to accept Islam. Known for her business acumen, wealth, and generosity.
data.etymology: Khadijeh belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Premature child.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khadijeh total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: خديجة
in_arabic.long_meaning: خديجة بنت خويلد، أول زوجة للنبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم، كانت امرأة ثرية وصادقة، اشتهرت بكونها أول من آمن برشالة النبي محمد من النساء. اسم خديجة مشتق من الجذر العربي 'خ-د-ج' والذي يعني 'الولادة المبكرة' أو 'الخديج'، وقد ورد في بعض الروايات أنها كانت تسمى 'خديجة' لكثرة خدوجها أي ولادتها لمكاسبها وتجارتها الناجحة.

in_urdu.name: خدیجہ
in_urdu.meaning: خدیجہ کا مطلب ہے سچي اور ایماندار خاتون
in_urdu.long_meaning: خدیجہ بنت خویلد، نبی محمد صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ وسلم کی پہلی زوجہ، ایک ثریدار اور ایماندار خاتون تھیں۔ ان کا نام خدیجہ عربی جڑ 'خ-د-ج' سے نکلا ہے جس کا مطلب ہے 'ابتدائی پیدائش' یا 'پیدائش سے قبل'. اسلامی روایات میں انھیں پہلی خاتون کے طور پر ذکر کیا گیا ہے جس نے نبی محمد کی رسولیت پر یقین کیا۔

in_hindi.meaning: खदीजा का अर्थ है सच्ची और ईमानदार महिला
in_hindi.long_meaning: खदीजा बिन्त खुवैलिद, नबी मुहम्मद की पहली पत्नी, एक धनी और सच्ची महिला थीं। इनका नाम 'ख-د-ज' अरबी जड़ से निकला है जिसका अर्थ है 'प्रारंभिक जन्म' या 'जन्म से पहले'। मुस्लिम परंपरा में उन्हें पहली महिला के रूप में जाना जाता है जिसने नबी मुहम्मद की रिसालत पर विश्वास किया।

in_english.name: Khadijeh
in_english.meaning: Truthful and Believing Woman, Born Early
in_english.long_meaning: Khadijeh bint Khuwaylid was the first wife of Prophet Muhammad, a wealthy and truthful woman known for being the first to believe in his prophethood. The name 'Khadijeh' stems from the Arabic root 'خ-د-ج' meaning 'premature birth' or 'born early'. In Islamic tradition, she is revered for her early acceptance of Islam and her role as a supportive partner to the Prophet.

data.cultural_impact: The name Khadijeh holds significant cultural impact within Islamic history and beyond, named for the esteemed Prophet Muhammad's (PBUH) first wife and the mother of his only surviving heir, Fatimah (RA). She was a successful businesswoman and an exemplary Muslim woman, providing companionship, financial support, and comfort to the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) during his early years, prior to receiving religious revelations. Khadijeh's unwavering support and love set a precedent of strong marital relationships, especially for Muslim women who seek guidance in their own marriages.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Khadijeh holds immense spiritual significance, as it represents the divine intervention and the fulfillment of promise in the life of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). Khadijeh, meaning 'a respectable lady,' embodied the virtues of confidence, trustworthiness, and nobility. Her supportive acceptance of Muhammad (PBUH) and belief in his prophethood set the stage for Muhammad's (PBUH) critically important role as a prophet, leader, and guide. As the first of the Prophet Muhammad's (PBUH) wives, Khadijeh's faithfulness, earnestness, and grace illuminated the path for the generosity, compassion, and courage that would come to define his life. In this regard, her name serves as a reminder of the blessings of unwavering faith, a steadfast heart, and steadfast love.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Khadijah bint Khuwaylid (555–619 CE) was a wealthy merchant's wife in Mecca, who was the first wife of the Prophet Muhammad. She was also the mother of his only surviving son, Ali.
